title: vidtoolz.resolveProductionReadRuntimeAttestation.v1
description: The ephemeral launcher's record of the isolated Resolve session it created. Written by tools/launch_isolated_session.py AFTER the profile seal and OUTSIDE the profile root, digest-pinned on the worker's command line, and re-verified at every operation. It closes coarse-timestamp ambiguity: the session nonce is generated after the seal and injected into the new process's environment, so a pre-existing process cannot carry it, and the record names the exact pid and start ticks the launcher observed. The nonce itself is never written here — only its sha256 — so the record can be read by a reviewer without becoming a credential.

session_id.description: the sealed profile's deterministic grant id

profile_sha256.description: sha256 of the session profile manifest FILE

policy_sha256.description: sha256 of the compiled policy FILE

authority_sha256.description: sha256 of the ACCEPTED authority record BYTES

nonce_sha256.description: sha256 of the session nonce that exists ONLY in the launched process's environment

spawn_pid.description: the process the launcher spawned; the attested Resolve pid is discovered by nonce, not assumed from this

resolve_start_ticks.description: /proc/<pid>/stat field 22; with boot_time it fixes the process instant exactly

boot_time.description: /proc/stat btime; a reboot invalidates the attestation

attestation_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of every other field
